title: Possessive adjectives
grammarTitle: Possessive adjectives: my / your / his / her / our / their
grammarNote: Притяжательные прилагательные показывают кому что-то принадлежит. В отличие от русского и казахского языков, они НЕ изменяются в зависимости от существительного — одна форма для всего! My brother, my sister, my family — всегда "my".

grammarTable.subject: I
grammarTable.example: my mother · my brother · my family · my name

grammarTable.subject: you
grammarTable.example: your father · your sister · your city

grammarTable.subject: he
grammarTable.example: his dream · his job · his name is Marat

grammarTable.subject: she
grammarTable.example: her cooking · her name is Ainur · her job

grammarTable.subject: we
grammarTable.example: our family · our tradition · our home

grammarTable.subject: they
grammarTable.example: their garden · their house · their children

rows.example: ✓ your name (притяж.) · ✓ you're a student = you are
✓ their garden (притяж.) · ✓ they're happy = they are
✓ its tail (притяж.) · ✓ it's a cat = it is
имя моего отца = my father's name is Marat
рисунки Даны = Dana's drawings are beautiful
My mother's job is very important.
His hobby is fishing. Her hobby is cooking.
Our family tradition is Friday dinner.

grammarTip:
Главное правило: притяжательное прилагательное зависит от ВЛАДЕЛЬЦА, а не от предмета!
My brother · my sister · my family — всё "my", не меняется!

Сравни с русским: МОЙ брат, МОЯ сестра, МОЯ семья — меняется
В английском: MY brother, MY sister, MY family — всегда MY! 🎯

exercises.text: Aizhan talks about ___ family every day.

exercises.instruction: Fill in the correct possessive adjective.
exercises.text: Arman and Dana live with ___ parents in Aktobe.
exercises.hint: Arman and Dana = they → their parents.

exercises.text: "His name is Marat" — "his" is correct here (talking about Aizhan's father).
___ hobby is cooking traditional Kazakh food. (about Aizhan's mother)
We love ___ family tradition — Friday dinner.

exercises.instruction: Fill in: his, her or their.
exercises.text: Dana's room is full of ___ beautiful pictures.

opts: She loves her brother's — his name is Arman.
exercises.correct: She loves her brother's — his name is Arman.
exercises.hint: "her brother's" is wrong here — just say "her brother". "She loves her brother — his name is Arman."
